Class InterleavingPhaseManagerConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.github.coffee4j.engine.process.interleaving.InterleavingPhaseManagerConfiguration
public class InterleavingPhaseManagerConfiguration extends Object
Configuration for a PhaseManager managing Interleaving Combinatorial Testing and Error-Constraint Generation, respectively.
